name: skillspore-workspace
description: Secure peer-to-peer sharing and installation of Agent Skills

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @skillspore/protocol build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/installer build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/transport build && pnpm --filter skillspore build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @skillspore/protocol build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/installer build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/transport build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.pack:cli: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && pnpm build && pnpm --filter skillspore pack --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.dev:cli: pnpm --filter @skillspore/protocol build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/installer build && pnpm --filter @skillspore/transport build && pnpm --filter skillspore dev
